description: This source file implements the prplmesh_cli class, providing command-line interface functionalities for prplMesh, including network mapping, device info, radio info, access point management, and status reporting.

classes.name: prplmesh_cli
classes.description: Main class providing CLI commands for prplMesh management and status reporting.

methods.name: get_ip_from_iface
methods.description: Retrieves IPv4 address of a network interface.

methods.name: get_freq_from_class
methods.description: Maps operating class to frequency in GHz.

methods.name: print_radio
methods.description: Prints radio, BSS, and connected client info for a device.

methods.name: print_device_info
methods.description: Recursively prints device and backhaul info.

methods.name: prpl_conn_map
methods.description: Builds and displays the network connection map.

methods.name: print_status
methods.description: Prints detailed status in pretty or JSON format.

methods.name: print_help
methods.description: Displays help text with available commands.

methods.name: get_ap_path
methods.description: Resolves access point path by SSID or object number.

methods.name: set_ssid
methods.description: Sets SSID for a specified access point.

methods.name: set_security
methods.description: Configures security mode and passphrase for an access point.
